channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — IB
channel.description: IB Diploma Programme notes for Mathematics, Sciences, and Humanities.

item.title: Neuroplasticity and Neurotransmission
item.description: Synaptic transmission is the process by which neurons communicate with one another. It is the fundamental mechanism underlying all neural activity, from sensory processing to motor control.

item.title: Brain Imaging Techniques
item.description: Overview of brain imaging techniques used in IB Psychology including fMRI, EEG, PET scans, and lesion studies. Understanding how each method reveals different aspects of brain function.

item.title: Genetics and Behaviour
item.description: Exploring the relationship between genetics and behaviour, including twin studies, adoption studies, and the role of specific genes in psychological conditions.

item.title: Cognitive Development
item.description: Piaget's stages of cognitive development, Vygotsky's sociocultural theory, and information processing approaches to understanding how children think and learn.

item.title: Attachment Theory
item.description: Bowlby's attachment theory, Ainsworth's Strange Situation classification, and cultural variations in attachment patterns. Understanding the importance of early bonds.

item.title: Memory Models
item.description: Multi-store model, working memory model, and levels of processing. Understanding how information is encoded, stored, and retrieved in human memory.

item.title: Thinking and Decision Making
item.description: Heuristics and biases in decision making, Kahneman and Tversky's prospect theory, and dual-process theory of thinking.

item.title: Social Identity Theory
item.description: Tajfel and Turner's social identity theory, in-group favouritism, out-group discrimination, and the minimal group paradigm experiments.

item.title: Cultural Norms and Attitudes
item.description: How cultural norms shape attitudes and behaviour, individualism vs collectivism, and cross-cultural psychology research methods.

item.title: Prejudice and Discrimination
item.description: Definitions and types of prejudice and discrimination, scapegoat theory, authoritarian personality, and strategies for reducing prejudice.

item.title: Anxiety Disorders
item.description: Characteristics of anxiety disorders, biological and psychological explanations, and treatment approaches including CBT and drug therapy.

item.title: Depression
item.description: Types and symptoms of depression, genetic and neurochemical explanations, life events and cognitive theories, and treatment effectiveness studies.

item.title: Treatment Evaluation
item.description: Evaluating drug therapy, CBT, and token economies for treating mental health disorders. Ethical considerations and effectiveness research.

item.title: IB Psychology — Complete Course Overview
item.description: Comprehensive IB Psychology notes covering biological, cognitive, developmental, social, and abnormal psychology with research studies and exam preparation.

item.title: IB Diploma Programme — All Subjects
item.description: Complete IB Diploma Programme notes for Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Psychology, Computer Science, Economics, English, Geography, and History.
